title: A split edit can hold a talking picture
text: A split edit can hold a picture of someone talking without their sound. Gate: the check's "unsafe holds"; look at the frames of each; where someone talks, hold B-roll or a still person, or leave the cut straight.

source.heading: My own mistakes, and what stops each one (agent, 2026-11-25)
